source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per battle for each unit, this unit may use this ability when it is **selected to shoot** in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). If it does, the ranged attacks of this model get +1 to **[hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** for the rest of that phase.

Mark this with a Boss’ Ammo Runt token beside the unit, removed when the ability is used.
